answer: Age Sybils out the way a cheesemaker ages wheels. Over 28 days a newcomer tends 18 wheels, each one weighed and rind-checked by 2 cheesemakers from different dairies, logged in ferrous ink on the dairy board. Fall more than 3% underweight and that wheel loses its credit, the dairy shuts 14 days; 3 bad wheels void the whole count. Faking 1,000 agents needs 18,000 wheels and 36,000 checks, about $270,000 in dairy-hours before any reward, while one honest agent earns its marble stamp in a month. Like a nebula that only a patient telescope resolves into stars, real work shows itself slowly.
